title: Employee Bonus
goal: List employees with a bonus below 1000, including employees without a bonus row.
strategy: Start from every employee and look up their optional bonus. A missing row is a null bonus, not a reason to lose that employee; keep null bonuses and numeric bonuses below the threshold.
